→ Turns her gaming sessions into must-watch content
→ Official Immutable Hero Creator

Her content style:
→ High energy gameplay videos

→ Video content hits different if you're not using it, you're missing opportunities

→ how to portray your journey in Web3

We are back with another episode of the Superstar Series [Ep. 10]

This week we're featuring someone most of you already know from the game nights ⤵️

Featuring: @Rikuuen

𝗪𝗵𝗼 𝗶𝘀 𝗥𝗶𝗸𝘂𝘂𝗲𝗻?

A Creator, Gamer, Event host and community builder from the Philippines. One of the most genuine guys in the web3 gaming space

𝗝𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗻𝗲𝘆 𝗛𝗶𝗴𝗵𝗹𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘁𝘀

When Rikuuen entered Web3 he knew nobody. His web2 circle was completely different and most of the time he was doing everything alone

But somewhere in that struggle he figured out one thing, find people who are hungry for growth not just for opportunity, Those are the ones who move with you when things get hard

As a Founder, building opportunities for his community wasn’t easy, especially when smaller groups kept getting overlooked

Still, he kept pushing forward

𝗘𝗰𝗼𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺𝘀 𝗛𝗲'𝘀 𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗼𝗹𝘃𝗲𝗱 𝗪𝗶𝘁𝗵

→ Community manager at @Immutable, handling things behind the scenes and hosting those game nights you all love 

→ He’s also a great video editor and graphic designer, contributing to the content you see.

→ Founder of @crimsonzealgg, A hub for creators and gamers with some of the best game nights in the space

𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗛𝗲 𝗟𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗱 𝗜𝗺𝗺𝘂𝘁𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗷𝗼𝗯? 

Met the Immutable team in Singapore, shared his vision for building and taking care of the community and made it clear what he could bring to the table

That mindset changed everything 💯

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗰𝗮𝗻 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗥𝗶𝗸𝘂𝘂𝗲𝗻?

→ Show up before the opportunity exists
→ Be clear about your value and what you bring to the table
→ Stay consistent even when growth feels slow
→ Build for your people not just for recognition
→ Bring energy and effort into everything you do

𝗢𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝘂𝗻𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗖𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀 [𝗧𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗢𝗻𝗲'𝘀 𝗙𝗼𝗿 𝗬𝗼𝘂]

He recently did a creator campaign with Clash of Coins through 𝗖𝗿𝗶𝗺𝘀𝗼𝗻 𝗭𝗲𝗮𝗹 and more are on the way. If you're a creator go check it out 🙌

𝗛𝗶𝘀 𝗩𝗶𝗲𝘄 𝗼𝗻 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗖𝘂𝗿𝗿𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗦𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗪𝗲𝗯𝟯 𝗚𝗮𝗺𝗶𝗻𝗴

Not everyone can trade or create content but anyone at any age can play a game. When gaming has its time again I want to be there having done the work!!

That right there says everything

𝗪𝗵𝘆 𝗪𝗲 𝗙𝗲𝗮𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲𝗱 𝗛𝗶𝗺

→ His consistency, he shows up every single day
→ Brings real energy into every event
→ Clear and honest opinions
→ People know they can count on him
→ His support for players, creators and teams shows real passion for Web3 gaming

People like Rikuuen matter in Web3, builders who genuinely care about the community and friends 😉

Web3 Superstars continues every week!

quoted_tweet.text:
So let me get this straight

Today, Donald Trump posted that the Strait of Hormuz is completely open for business. At the exact same hour, Keir Starmer flew to Paris to co-host a forty-nation virtual summit with Emmanuel Macron about how to, and I am not kidding, reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

AND they did not invite the US Navy. The Navy that cleared the mines, turned back the tankers, and actually reopened the strait.

Forty flags. Zero destroyers. Zero mines cleared. 

One (1) excellent buffet, probably.

This is forty guys showing up to a house fire three hours late with a PowerPoint titled "Fire Response Coordination Initiative," while the homeowner is already back inside watching TV.

Meanwhile, Iran's foreign minister fully capitulated on camera today. Oil crashed 11% in minutes. Iran has reportedly agreed to suspend its nuclear program indefinitely and will not receive any frozen funds. Trump says the deal is mostly done.

And the S&P 500 is at an all-time high. That is the market, which has no feelings and no podcast, looking at all of this and saying: yeah, this is working. Where are all the Panicans now?

None of this is really about Iran, though. It is about Xi.

Panama is out of Belt and Road. Venezuela is cut off from Chinese oil. Indonesia just signed a defense deal with the US. The Philippines is in. Iran just folded. That is Hormuz, Malacca, and the Luzon Strait. Roughly 80% of China's seaborne oil, all within one phone call of being squeezed.

When Trump sits down with Xi, there is no real negotiation left. 

Xi is already picking which hand to lose first
